1.

The pearl Christ has found, Which was His soul’s desire, For which He sacrificed all And died on the cross here.

2.

He sought and with joy found His pearl, yes, His bride; All that He possessed He gave up And purchased her for God.

3.

A pearl rare, precious, fair She was in His eyes; She was redeemed with His blood, His beauty now she has.

4.

His beloved for evermore He bears upon His heart And cleanses in the washing of water by the word On the wilderness path here.

5.

Soon without spot or wrinkle He will present to Himself His costly bride in snow-white attire, Pure and blameless.

6.

Our Lord, Thee we now praise, Teach us to esteem more Thy love for the assembly, Which Thou didst dearly purchase here.
